replay: reads the RGB, measured depth and camera of the 7 arrived frames only; query and history frames contribute their cameras (metadata) to render predictions; every opened file is audited per episode and must belong to an arrived frame
pre_update_features: computed from the CACHE state rendered at the 7 arrived frames and their measured RGB-D only; no query or history camera, image or depth
geometry: R7 from the measured depth of the 7 arrived frames (teacher path, purpose logged) at the query and history cameras
scoring: query and history depth are read only after every seal of the cohort is complete; the fixed action is chosen on CAJU_SEL and its record hashed before any CAJU_EVAL depth is read
